evals.prompt: Analyse a PDF paper containing model architecture, loss functions, and a detection workflow. Draft an English invention-patent research package for inventor and jurisdiction-appropriate professional review. Produce separate claims, specification, abstract, and abstract figure. Core equations must be native editable Office Math, and every material claim feature must map to a source page or equation.
evals.expected_output: A complete English patent research draft package with stable source IDs, evidence ledger, claim-feature map, editable equations, a claim-aligned main flowchart, methodology figures, separate DOCX files, and passing validation reports.

evals.prompt: The paper is a scanned PDF and OCR is unclear for some equations. First extract the confirmed technical solution and draft claims. Do not guess uncertain symbols.
evals.expected_output: An OCR-aware claim draft that marks uncertain source blocks, excludes unsupported limitations from formal claims, lists specific inventor questions, and does not fabricate equation symbols.

evals.prompt: Compare a paper with an existing patent. Check support for each patent-claim feature, identifying paper-only and patent-only content and differences in scope, with exact source locators.
evals.expected_output: Separate source maps plus a bidirectional feature table using the declared relationship labels, exact locators for both documents, and no assumption that patent-only text is paper-supported.
